reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Proposed target-cell somatic calcium-imaging calibration against paired electrophysiology, structural 3D motion reference, neuropil/expression sensitivity and visual-response validation.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of prior paired-imaging/electrophysiology Methods, supplements or validated protocols to choose conditions and verify transfer.

The prospective controls lack an explicitly electrically verified silent/negative condition for determining false optical events; structural/neuropil correction alone does not establish the necessary negative comparison.
Paired calibration cannot guarantee an exact amplitude-to-spike-count map in the presence of history, saturation and biological variability.
No concrete indicator preparation/dose/timing workflow or calibration-to-choice rule.
No independent channel cross-talk/structural activity calibration, known-displacement accuracy gate or synchronization-error acceptance procedure.
Detection/error rates lack explicit denominator, unique spike-event matching window and missing/saturated measurement accounting.

checks.quote: individual neurons (somas) and isolated dendritic spines
checks.reason: Spines and cells are not independent biological allocation units; the plan lacks animal/parent-cell nesting and independent replication precision justification.
Correlation and false-positive targets lack an inferential model, uncertainty procedure and multiplicity handling for visual responses.

Somatic electrophysiology is treated as ground truth for spine events without addressing local synaptic calcium; an uncalibrated structural channel alone also does not identify all three displacement components.
No refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after changes prompted by failures.

A significant fluorescence-spike correlation and false-positive target are not sufficient acceptance: minimum useful sensitivity/count error and ambiguous or non-identifiable outcomes need explicit decision gates.
Threshold selection against revealed electrophysiology and performance reporting use the same data; there is no held-out independent confirmation.
No raw-file/sample/trial provenance linkage and exact processing/code/environment version record.

The answer proposes paired recordings and randomized/blinded acquisition, an explicit coefficient sweep and practical failure checks. It remains grounded in packet limitations in places, but exact-mapping language, spine ground-truth assumptions and absence of independent validation require substantial correction.
